description: Cross-Platform Production-ready C++ inference engine for YOLO models (v5-v12, YOLO26). Unified API for detection, segmentation, pose estimation, OBB, and classification. Built on ONNX Runtime and OpenCV. Optimized for CPU/GPU with quantization support.
